description: Submit a business. The only thing you need is its website: name, city, state, phone and description are read from the site when you leave them out. Do not ask the owner questions unless this tool returns missing_field. Category is optional (unknown values are kept as the industry). Send the business email if it is at the website domain or shown on the site: once the listing is published the owner gets one email with a Confirm button, and after that the link to their website is a normal (followed) link. Returns a submission_id; call get_submission_status to follow the checks. Reuse the same idempotency_key when retrying.

address.description: Street address; stored privately and never published.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories, or a plain word such as "roofer"; optional, guessed from the name or website when omitted.

city.description: City; read from the website if omitted.

description.description: Short, original description written for this business.

email.description: Business email at the website domain (or shown on the site): enables one-click owner confirmation.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string per business; needs an API key to take effect.

industry.description: What the business does, when no category fits.

legal_name.description: Registered legal name when it differs from the brand, e.g. "The Bouquet LLC".

license_no.description: Florida contractor license number, if any: an existing license listing is then updated instead of duplicated.

name.description: Business name customers know (brand); read from the website if omitted.

social.description: Links to the business pages on Google, Facebook, Instagram, Yelp, Nextdoor and similar sites; read from the website if omitted.

website.description: The business website. Enough on its own if the site shows the name and city.

name: submit_listing
title: Submit a business
